scientific_limitations: The three-dimensional polynomial for normalized clearance below one is classical through the union of perpendicular cylinders. Claimed extensions are the exact finite-cube three-dimensional continuation, all-dimensional first-clipping regularity and coefficient, and sharp upper-tail law. Full profiles in dimensions over three are not supplied. Historical priority is provisional; complete texts of relevant older reports were inaccessible.
title: Exact edge-clearance law and first clipping singularity of Euclidean hypercubes
